name: linkedin-networking
description: Compliant networking helper: find companies to research and Haas / MBA alumni to reach out to, then draft outreach and track it. NEVER touches LinkedIn (no scraping, no reading profiles, no auto-send) — it sources companies via Vibe Prospecting, builds Sales Navigator + Alumni-tool searches for you to run manually, drafts messages via the product-networking skill, and tracks contacts + warm intros via Rolodex. Auto-fires on LinkedIn URLs / networking intent via a UserPromptSubmit hook.
